reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text: I was a subscriber since 2019 and loved it for the first couple of years, but around 2025 things started going downhill. Like any company, they got super greedy, prices jumped to nearly $30 a month, features that used to be included were pulled out and turned into separate paid apps, and the value just wasn’t there anymore. On top of that, customer support became painfully slow, it could take hours to get a response. The final straw was constantly having trouble accessing the app at all. Paying that much and not even being able to use the service is unacceptable. Save your money and look elsewhere.

reviews.title: No support
reviews.text: I can’t contact support, I click on support and it does nothing. Every time I send an estimate or an invoice it deletes the contact information from the document and then I need to edit the document to add the contact information back. This has been going on for months and none of the updates have done anything to even give me the ability to contact support about this. Fix it and I will change my review, but until then you this app irritates me and I will probably just end up changing to something else

reviews.title: MAJOR PROBLEMS!!!!! You dont want 2 pay 4 this app unless it gets fixed!!!! Not worth the headache!!
reviews.text: Since the last couple updates this app has been buggy and increasingly worse to the point that after using for several years we are going to have to quit. It started by not saving the names on the invoices after a change while still in the file. But I just noticed today that it is deleting all the names from almost all previous invoices!!??? I tried to use the support option within the app but it doesn’t work either. This is good-bye unless I’m contacted with a fix immediately, bc obviously you can’t run a business with this kind of nonsense going on, it’s extremely aggravating!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Love the app (but always dealing with bugs)
reviews.text:
First off, I’ve used this app for over 5 years now and have paid for premium for the entire time. I absolutely love Billdu more than any other estimating app, and I’ve tried them all. 

My issues- it always seems to be bugged, new ones pop up, they take care of it and then new bugs come up again. It’s frustrating. The newest issue is that all my estimates keep getting deleted even after being saved. If they aren’t getting deleted, it will constantly delete the name of the person to which I’m doing the estimate for. I have to keep going in and typing the persons name in again and if I work on that estimate at all it will constantly keep asking me to input the name again that I already have saved into the program. It’s outrageously annoying and I wish there was a way for me to convey this stuff to Billdu but there’s no way to do that.

Also, I’ve had a couple of times where I go into the app and all the estimates that I created in the last week are just gone. Deleted. I spend a lot of time working on these and it’s outrageously  frustrating that they just get deleted. 

I figure that all the times the site is “down for maintenance” it will fix these issues, but I’ve been dealing with these issues for quite a while now with no update to fix. I’m now contemplating leaving Billdu and finding new software to use. I’d rather not, but I am still hoping that this can be fixed.

reviews.title: Used to be great, now awful
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Billdu for about 6 or 7 years now. It used to be fantastic but as they have added more and more functionality, ironically its functionality has diminished. I have had the same issue for about a year:
The name of the invoice recipient gets deleted. It used to be only after you made an adjustment to the invoice (eg added a payment, sent a reminder, sent a thank you message) but now it happens the instant you send the invoice. I now have to screenshot my invoice list EVERY time I use it.
To add insult to injury, their “Help” button never works and just buffers.
Then you try finding someone, anyone, to help - turns out that’s a needles and haystacks job. I ended up going onto TrustPilot reviews and searching through to see if they ever responded to anyone and got an email address that way.
Surprisingly, I got a response telling me it was a glitch and it was all resolved. It isn’t. I wrote back and haven’t heard a thing.
I renewed my annual subscription in December which I deeply regret as I will be going elsewhere for the start of my tax year.

reviews.title: Subscriptions
reviews.text: This rating is more on the support side of things, I have been using this app now for over 5 years now with several businesses, however I feel this past year I have had several issues, so I go to send or create a quote and it tells me my subscription has run out and I need to subscribe which then don’t allow me to create anything, I thing click on a subscription and it tells me I’m already subscribed, to which I then contact support which they are quick to respond for first 10 mins and then suddenly stop responding, as a business we should have straight forward guidance and be able to rectify these common issues, yet again I’ve now had to download another quoting app and subscribe to that due to delays on the support side which could cost me further works going forward, I wish this could be resolved a lot more quicker so it does not cost people down the line, overall it is a good app and easy to use but the support is the downside
